title: Devils’ Crest Anime Unveils Additional Voice Cast Members
content:
The production team for the upcoming Devils’ Crest anime has revealed the voice actors for four of the show’s characters. They also released several character and VA visuals alongside the news. Devils’ Crest ’s newest voice actors include:

• Maaya Uchida (Rikka in Love, Chunibyo & Other Delusion!) as Aria Misono

• Rie Murakawa (Hotaru in Non Non Biyori) as Kai Kisanuki

• Sora Amamiya (Akame in Akame ga Kill!) as Sumika Watamaki

• Yuusuke Kobayashi (Subaru in Re: ZERO) as Teruki Sugamo

Devils’ Crest’s production team had previously announced that Konomi Inagaki and Haruka Shiraishi would voice Sawa Ashihara and Yuuma Ashihara. During AX 2026 the production team announced that Ado would perform the anime’s opening song “Shinka.” The AX 2026 video and a trailer can be seen below:

The anime’s production staff includes:

• Shinji Ushiro — Chief Director

• Kenchirou Komaya — Director

• Eiji Umehara — Scripts

• Naoyuki Chikatani — Music

• Yuki Hayashi — Music

• Yukiko Horiguchi — Character Design

Production I.G. will animate the adaptation.

The anime adapts Reki Kawahara’s ( Sword Art Online, Accel World ) and Yukuko Horiguchi’s Demons’ Crest light novel. Dengeki Bunko (Kadokawa) has serialized the light novel since its November 2022 debut. Kadokawa has released four volumes. In 2022, Koroku Takano and TOmoe adapted the light novel into a webtoon. Yen Press published the English version of Demons’ Crest.

Devils’ Crest follows Yuuma Ashihara, a grade school student who was “lucky” enough to beta test Actual Magic, a VRMMO. While Yuuma fawned over the game’s realism, his amazement turned to horror when he tried to log out. The game somehow bled into the real world and changed reality to the point where some of his classmates were transformed into monstrous beings ! Now trapped in a life-or-death situation, Yuuma and his classmates must fight to survive.

The anime will premiere on Amazon Prime Video on November 6.
author: Anime Corner

title: Katekyo Hitman Reborn! Anime Reveals Ninth Ending Featuring "Suberidai" by Mori Tsubasa
content:
Katekyo Hitman REBORN! anime has officially released the creditless version of its ninth ending, featuring the song “Suberidai” by Mori Tsubasa. The song was used in Episodes 102-114, while the new video was released as part of the series’ 20th anniversary celebration.

The release follows yesterday’s release of the fifth opening, featuring the song “last cross” performed by Masami Mitsuoka . The releases are part of “REBORN! MUSIC MONTH,” a September-long music project celebrating the anime’s 20th anniversary. As previously reported, the campaign will have creditless versions of the series’ past theme song sequences released daily on the official YouTube channel.

These creditless sequences were previously included with physical releases of the anime but had not been officially made available online. You can watch the latest entry below.

The campaign began on September 1 with an official 25-song playlist featuring opening themes, ending themes and other music from the TV anime.

The manga by Akira Amano ran in Weekly Shonen Jump from May 2004 to November 2012, ending with a total of 42 compilation volumes. The series also received an anime adaptation, which ran for 203 episodes from October 7, 2006 to September 25, 2010. Studio Artland handled the production. The anime is available on Crunchyroll , who describe the story: Tsuna, a timid junior high student, is a failure at school, sports, and social life. But everything around Tsuna has been completely changed when a baby called Reborn, who claims to be an Italian hit man from Vongola family shows up! Reborn was sent to groom Tsuna for his future life as a mafia boss of the family!
author: Anime Corner

title: Umamusume To Sponsor the 2026 Motul Grand Prix of Japan
content:
Umamusume: Pretty Derby has announced a sponsor partnership with MotoGP™ ahead of the 2026 edition of the Motul Grand Prix of Japan. As part of the sponsorship, a 509′ (155 meters) sign featuring Oguri Cap, Tamamo Cross, Daiwa Scarlet, Jungle Pocket, Agnes Tachyon, Almond Eye, and Lucky Lilac will adorn the race circuit. Umamusume illustrations will be placed by the Motul Grand Prix of Japan’s grandstand entrance. Additionally, Tomoyo Takayanagi ( Oguri Cap ‘s VA), will be the Moto2 and Moto3 flag girl.

This Motul Grand Prix of Japan will be held at the Motegi Circuit in Tochigi Prefecture from October 2 to 4. The Moto2 and Moto3 races are scheduled for Sunday, October 4.

The Moto3 race is an entry-level category designated for lightweight 250cc bikes and younger riders; the Moto2 race features intermediate riders on 765cc motorcycles. The upcoming Japanese race is one of several global Grand Prix races. Tickets for the MotoGP™ Motul Grand Prix of Japan range from a three-day general admission ticket valued at $92.50 (~ ¥14,410) to the three-day Victory Deck Grandstand Seats, which retail for $1666.57 (~ ¥259,707). You can view a short promotional video of the race below.

Umamusume: Pretty Derby ‘s sponsorship of the Motul Grand Prix of Japan marks the second time the franchise has collaborated with a non-horse racing sporting event. Earlier this year, the franchise sponsored the Pacific Racing Team at the Super GT series (car racing). Cygames, Inc. has sponsored and collaborated with various horse racing events, including prestigious races like the Qatar Prix de l’Arc de Triomphe , Grand Premio Latinoamericano , and the Breeders’ Cup .

Cygames, Inc. is the parent company of Umamusume: Pretty Derby , a mobile game that features anthropomorphic versions of real-life racehorses. The mobile game has been adapted into several TV anime, OVAs, manga, and a theatrical film.

title: Solo Leveling: Karma Game Unveils Gameplay Overview, Cinematic Story Trailer
content:
Netmarble 's Solo Leveling : Karma game revealed a gameplay overview and cinematic story trailer for the game on Thursday at Tokyo Game Show. The gameplay overview shows the general mechanics and gameplay loop of the game, while the story trailer previews the game's story (The game takes place during a certain gap in time, during a part of the webtoon series that has not yet been covered in the anime. The videos below contain major spoilers for that part of the story.)

A-1 Pictures animated the game's opening video. Yūya Horiuchi and Yoshihiro Kanno were the storyboard artists and creative directors for the opening. Tomoko Sudo was the character designer, shibito was the animation director, and Yoshihiro Kanno was the action director.

The first season of the anime of writer Chugong and the late artist DUBU 's ( REDICE STUDIO ) Solo Leveling webtoon debuted in Japan in January 2024. Crunchyroll added the English dub of the anime in the same month.

Solo Leveling -ReAwakening- , a compilation film for the Solo Leveling anime's first season and a preview of the first two episodes of the second season, screened in Japan from November to December 2024. Crunchyroll and Sony Pictures screened Solo Leveling -ReAwakening- in December 2024 in select theaters in the U.S. and Canada.

The second season debuted in January 2025. Crunchyroll streamed the second season and also streamed an English dub .

The franchise is getting a new anime film titled Solo Leveling: Beyond the System , which continues the story after the second season.

The webtoon adaptation of Chugong 's Solo Leveling novel series, with illustrations by DUBU , launched on WEBTOON in March 2018 and ended in December 2021. Yen Press publishes the manhwa version and original novel series in English in print, and several services including Tapas release the web novel and webtoon digitally. Kadokawa publishes the webtoon in Japanese under the title Ore Dake Level-Up na Ken (I'm the Only One Who Has Leveled Up).

The webtoon is also inspiring a Korean live-action adaptation.

title: New Lollipop Chainsaw Game Announced for 2027 Release on PS5
content:
Nada Holdings and Dragami Games announced a new game in the Lollipop Chainsaw franchise titled Lollipop Chainsaw 2 Back2Back during Tokyo Game Show on Thursday. The game will launch for the PlayStation 5 in 2027. Final Fantasy XV director Hajime Tabata is directing the game, with his JP Universe company developing. Original Lollipop Chainsaw writer Masahiro Yuki is writing the game's story, and the original game's character designer NekoshowguN is also involved with the new game.

Dragami Games unveiled gameplay footage of the new game during TGS, but has no official upload. The below video is from Taiwanese game news website Bahamut Game Crazy.

Taiwan's Nada Holdings announced in July 2025 that its new projects for the Lollipop Chainsaw franchise in partnership with Dragami Games will involve a new game and an anime adaptation. Nada Holdings noted that the new game will not impose "excessive creative restrictions in the name of DEI (Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion)," but does not specify how exactly it will do this.

The Lollipop Chainsaw hack-and-slash zombie game launched for PlayStation 3 and Xbox 360 worldwide in June 2012. Grasshopper Manufacture developed the game, and Kadokawa Games and Warner Bros. Interactive Entertainment published the game. The game was a collaboration between Gōichi Suda (Suda51) and filmmaker James Gunn.

Former CEO of Kadokawa Games and current CEO of Dragami Games Yoshimi Yasuda posted a message on X/Twitter in English and Japanese in July 2022 that his company purchased the IP from Kadokawa Games after the status of the game was in limbo. He added Warner Bros. is supporting Dragami Games in this endeavor.

Kadokawa Games divested part of its business to the new company Dragami Games in May 2022. Kadokawa Games ' president and CEO Yasuda and company director Satoshi Fuyuno established Dragami Games in May 2022.

Lollipop Chainsaw RePOP , the remaster of the original game, launched digitally in the Americas and Europe for PS5, Xbox Series X|S, Switch, and PC via Steam in September 2024. The Switch 2 version debuted on May 28 earlier this year.

title: Live-Action Series The Remarried Empress Releases Main Trailer, Key Visual
content:
Disney+ and Hulu released the main trailer and key visual on Wednesday for the webtoon- and web novel-based live-action series The Remarried Empress ahead of its November 4 debut .

The trailer introduces the four main characters through their respective lines of dialogue, highlighting their personalities and relationships. In less than two minutes, the video quickly establishes the dynamics between the central characters.

The first four episodes will debut on Disney+ and Hulu on November 4, and the services will release two new episodes every Wednesday through the series finale on November 25 (for a total of 10 episodes).

The Remarried Empress revolves around Navier, the perfect Empress of the Eastern Empire, who chooses divorce after discovering that her husband, Emperor Sovieshu, plans to replace her with his mistress. Determined to reclaim her status, Navier resolves to become an Empress in another land.

The teaser highlights the strained relationship between Navier (played by Min-A Shin ), Sovieshu ( Ji-Hoon Ju ), Rashta ( Se Young Lee ), and Heinrey ( Jong Suk Lee ) as the imperial romance develops into a major political and personal conflict.

Suwon Cho is directing the series with scripts by Geena Yeoh and Choong-Yeol Hyun .

The webtoon has over 2.9 billion global views and has been translated into 10 languages. The series has a strong international following, particularly in Japan.

The webtoon ended in January after a seven-year run, but will return this fall for side stories.

The English version of the The Remarried Empress webtoon is available on WEBTOON. Ize Press is releasing the series in print.
author: ANN

title: Entergram Announces Koyo -RE-Nium Visual Novel Starring Hololive VTuber Hakui Koyori
content:
Entergram opened a teaser website on Thursday to announce the KOYO -RE- NIUM visual novel starring hololive VTuber Hakui Koyori, who also supervises the game. No other details of the game were announced, and the official website will open on October 22.

Entergram also revealed a key visual with Hakui wearing a game-original school uniform costume:

Hakui is from the sixth generation of hololive, and is the self-proclaimed "brains of the operation" in the Secret Society holoX.

The game will be the fourth collaboration between hololive and Entergram. Previous games include Okayunyumu! and its sequel Okayunyumu! R with VTuber Nekomata Okayu, and AQUARIUM with now-former VTuber Minato Aqua.

title: Dragon Quest Monsters: The Withered World Game Posts Gameplay Trailer
content:
Square Enix unveiled a new gameplay trailer for its Dragon Quest Monsters: The Withered World game on Thursday.

English trailer:

Japanese trailer:

The game will launch for Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam and Windows on December 3.

The game stars Bianca and Nera from the Dragon Quest V: Hand of the Heavenly Bride title. Debora from the same game also appears. There are over 500 monsters.

The game's Japanese name is Dragon Quest Monsters 4: Kareki no Kuni no Bianca・Flora (Bianca and Flora in the Withered World). Flora is Nera's original Japanese name.

Dragon Quest Monsters: The Dark Prince ( Dragon Quest Monsters 3 ), the most recent game in the series, launched on Switch in December 2023 and on PC via Steam , iOS, and Android in September 2024.

The first Dragon Quest Monsters game debuted in Japan in 1998 and in English in 2000 under the title Dragon Warrior Monsters . The game got a remake for Nintendo 3DS titled Dragon Quest Monsters: Terry's Wonderland 3D in Japan in May 2012. The remake got a release for smartphones in 2018 titled Dragon Quest Monsters: Terry's Wonderland SP . The port of the original game launched for Switch and smartphones in 2019 as Dragon Quest Monsters: Terry's Wonderland Retro . The original game and its remake star Terry, a character originally featured in Dragon Quest VI: Realms of Revelation .

title: FuRyu Streams Crymelight Game's Opening Video
content:
FuRyu began streaming the opening video for its CRYMELIGHT game on Thursday. The video announces and previews the game's theme song "Love and Guilt" by Hitomi Sekine as her character Mary.

CRYMELIGHT is the latest installment in its CRY series of "dark bishōjo action" game series that includes the CRYSTAR game and the CRYMACHINA action role-playing game .

The game is a roguelike that will launch on November 5 for PlayStation 5, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC via Steam . A deluxe edition of the game includes six DLC items, a digital artbook, and a digital album with 11 soundtrack songs and three voice drama tracks.

FuRyu describes the game:

Following the events of 2019's CRYSTAR and 2023's CRYMACHINA, CRYMELIGHT follows a young girl known only as “Alice” after she wakes up with no memories of her past and discovers she must journey to the lowest layer of Purgatory to earn her “Rebirth.” Alice must set out from the Tea Party Hall, defeat enemies born from the depths of madness, and confess and confront the sins she has committed, undergoing immense emotional growth in the process.

In the game, players travel between the "Wonderland" realm and "The Tea Party" realm. "Wonderland" is a prison where souls of the dead are held captive, and "The Tea Party" is a sanctuary that offers "respite to young girls burdened by their sins."

Naoki Hisaya is the plot and story supervisor, and is returning from previous entries in the CRY series. Other returning staff members from previous entries include composer Sakuzyo and animator RIRI Yamashita . YOGISYA is the character designer.
author: ANN

title: Un:Me Game's Trailer Reveals 2027 Delay, Yumiri Hanamori Casting
content:
Shueisha Games unveiled a new trailer for historia Inc.'s Un:Me horror game on Wednesday. The video announces the game's delay to 2027, and announces that voice actress Yumiri Hanamori is playing the game's main character.

The game will release for Switch 2, PlayStation 5, and PC via Steam . The game was previously slated to release this year.

Shueisha Games describes the story:

A girl awakens in a mysterious labyrinth.Four voices echo within her mind.They are human "souls" drifting through this maze.Each of the four souls seeks to fulfill their own desires, attempting to seize control of the girl's body and act on their own will.What are these four souls, truly?Who created this enigmatic labyrinth—and why?Who is this girl?Through dialogue with each soul and by overcoming their individual traumas, you'll navigate deeper into the labyrinth.The answers await those who persist...

In the psychological adventure game, players control a girl who has souls inside her that seize control. Each soul carries unique traumas from the past.

contentBlocks.text: Shueisha Games unveiled a new trailer for historia Inc.'s Un:Me horror game on Wednesday. The video announces the game's delay to 2027, and announces that voice actress Yumiri Hanamori is playing the game's main character.
The game will release for Switch 2, PlayStation 5, and PC via Steam . The game was previously slated to release this year.
Shueisha Games describes the story:
